identity.name: Dark population transfer sterile neutrino dark matter
identity.short_description: A two-step sterile-neutrino dark matter mechanism in which active-neutrino scattering-induced decoherence first populates a heavier sterile state N1, and sterile-sector self-interactions transfer that population to a lighter sterile state N2 that survives as dark matter or a dark-matter component.
identity.historical_origin_or_motivation: Motivated by evading X-ray and structure-formation bounds on minimal Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino dark matter by decoupling the light sterile-neutrino relic abundance from its active-sterile mixing angle.

G_phi = g_phi^2 / m_phi^2 heavy-mediator limit

possible subdominant Standard Model decay branches of N1
